acceptance_criteria.description: Fresh init records bounded attribution for the original uniform Cargo EOL style without storing Cargo content or absolute paths.

After an external whole-file LF/CRLF normalization, remove deletes only Pumarejo-owned Cargo projections and restores the original uniform EOL style and exact pre-init bytes when no other content changed.
Mixed EOL inputs remain byte-preserving in ordinary init/remove; missing, duplicate, forged, or unsupported EOL attribution and modified owned projections fail closed.
Focused Cargo/init/remove/doctor tests, build, and root real-Tinto cached journey plus exact hash restoration pass.

closed_decisions: Root proved the Cargo planner round-trips the original CRLF source exactly, while the real Tauri/Cargo launch externally normalized all 75 line endings to LF before removal.
Persist only a bounded uniform EOL attribution (LF or CRLF), never full Cargo content, line maps, paths, secrets, or raw diffs.
Normalization resilience applies only when the current Cargo file is itself uniform and all existing owned projection and manifest checks pass; mixed current content must not be globally rewritten.
Unrelated textual edits remain preserved; only line-ending style may be restored to the attributed pre-init uniform convention.

focused: pnpm vitest run tests/unit/attributed-drift.test.ts tests/integration/init.test.ts tests/integration/remove.test.ts tests/integration/doctor.test.ts
natural: Root repeats cached disposable real-Tinto init/ready/surface/snapshot/close/remove and matches the original Cargo SHA-256.

forbidden_changes: Do not store Cargo content, absolute paths, raw diffs, or arbitrary line-ending maps in the manifest.
Do not edit provider source, dialog/process custody, dependencies/lockfiles, public schemas outside bounded attribution, git, Jira, queue/blocker/release files, or Tinto worktrees.
Do not normalize mixed current Cargo files, weaken projection/hash validation, or remove unrelated developer content.
objective: Make attributable Cargo removal restore the original uniform line-ending convention after a real Tauri/Cargo journey normalizes the manifest.
